steps.en: The decision to continue is recorded
steps.why_en: The portal has no step where this decision is made or stored.
steps.why_id: Portal tidak punya langkah tempat keputusan ini dibuat atau disimpan.

steps.en: User can fill in the driver's details
steps.why_en: Form is always open for FIN; not tied to the expired work pass decision.
steps.why_id: Form selalu terbuka untuk FIN; tidak terkait keputusan work pass kedaluwarsa.

steps.why_en: Saving works for any ID type; it is not specific to an expired work pass.
steps.why_id: Penyimpanan berlaku untuk semua jenis ID, tidak khusus work pass kedaluwarsa.
